title: Rape
meaning: Defines rape and the circumstances of consent or lack of consent covered by the provision.
note: Official section heading. 64–71 address punishments and related sexual offences; exceptions and age rules must be read in full.

title: Gang rape
meaning: Addresses rape by a group or persons acting in furtherance of a common intention.
note: Official section heading. Definitions, victim age and the applicable subsection determine the legal consequences.

title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
quote: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty.
meaning: Addresses assault or criminal force against a woman with the specified intention or knowledge.
note: Official section heading. The legal ingredients and evidence must be assessed; a description alone does not establish guilt.

title: Sexual harassment
meaning: Covers the specified forms of sexual harassment, including unwelcome sexual conduct, demands, pornography and sexually coloured remarks.
note: Official section heading. Workplace POSH procedures are a separate legal route that may also apply.

title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to disrobe
quote: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to disrobe.
meaning: Addresses assault or criminal force, or its abetment, with the specified intent to disrobe a woman or compel her to be naked.
note: Official section heading. Seek urgent assistance if there is a present threat.

title: Voyeurism
meaning: Addresses watching, capturing or disseminating images of a woman engaged in a private act in the circumstances specified.
note: Official section heading. The definition of a private act and consent conditions are significant.

title: Stalking
meaning: Covers specified repeated following or contact and monitoring a woman’s electronic communication.
note: Official section heading. Read the statutory exceptions and evidence requirements.

title: Dowry death
meaning: Addresses a woman’s death in the specified circumstances within seven years of marriage with the required connection to dowry-related cruelty or harassment.
note: Official section heading. Every ingredient, timing and evidence must be assessed.

title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
quote: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty.
meaning: Creates an offence for the cruelty addressed by section 86 by a husband or his relative.
note: Official section heading. Domestic Violence Act civil protections may also be relevant; the legal tests differ.
keywords: domestic abuse husband cruelty dowry family

title: Hiring, employing or engaging a child to commit an offence
quote: Hiring, employing or engaging a child to commit an offence.
meaning: Addresses using a child to commit an offence, with additional consequences if the offence is committed.
note: Official section heading. Other child-protection statutes may also apply.

title: Culpable homicide
meaning: Defines causing death with specified intention or knowledge.
note: Official section heading. This is a definition; punishment and distinctions from murder require sections 101 and 103–105 and the facts.

title: Murder
meaning: Defines when culpable homicide is murder, subject to the stated exceptions.
note: Official section heading. Section 103 concerns punishment; exceptions and intent cannot be decided from a short account.

title: Causing death by negligence
meaning: Addresses death caused by rash or negligent conduct in the applicable circumstances.
note: Official section heading. The initial BNS commencement excluded section 106(2). Verify later commencement notifications before relying on that subsection.
keywords: accident negligent death rash hit run

title: Attempt to murder
meaning: Addresses an act with the intention or knowledge and circumstances specified for attempted murder.
note: Official section heading. Injury alone does not determine the offence; intention and surrounding evidence matter.

title: Organised crime
meaning: Addresses continuing unlawful activity by organised crime syndicates in the statutory circumstances.
note: Official section heading. The defined syndicate, continuing activity and other conditions must be established.

title: Petty organised crime
meaning: Addresses specified criminal activity by members of a group or gang in the circumstances of the section.
note: Official section heading. Do not apply the label to every isolated theft or fraud.

title: Terrorist act
meaning: Defines and addresses terrorist acts and associated conduct.
note: Official section heading. Special-law interaction, including UAPA, and the competent decision under the section require specialist advice.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt
meaning: Addresses intentional or knowing infliction of hurt as specified.
note: Official section heading. Definitions, injury type, exceptions and related sections affect the charge.

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
meaning: Addresses voluntarily causing hurt that meets the statutory grievous-hurt definition.
note: Official section heading. Section 116 defines grievous hurt; medical evidence and the applicable subsection matter.

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by use of acid, etc.
quote: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by use of acid, etc.
meaning: Addresses acid-related grievous hurt and the other conduct specified in its subsections.
note: Official section heading. Urgent medical care and preservation of records are priorities.

title: Wrongful restraint
meaning: Addresses unlawfully preventing a person from proceeding in a direction they have a right to take.
note: Official section heading. Read the exception and distinguish restraint from confinement.

title: Wrongful confinement
meaning: Addresses wrongful restraint that prevents movement beyond certain circumscribed limits.
note: Official section heading. Duration, purpose and other circumstances can affect the applicable subsection.

title: Kidnapping
meaning: Defines kidnapping from India and from lawful guardianship and provides punishment.
note: Official section heading. Age, consent and lawful guardianship are central. Abduction is separately defined in section 138.

title: Trafficking of person
meaning: Addresses recruitment, transport, harbouring, transfer or receipt of persons for exploitation using specified means.
note: Official section heading. The statutory definition, age and role of consent must be read in full.

title: Unlawful compulsory labour
meaning: Addresses unlawfully compelling a person to labour against their will.
note: Official section heading. Article 23 and bonded-labour legislation can also matter.

title: Act endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India
quote: Act endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India.
meaning: Addresses the specified intentional or knowing acts affecting sovereignty, unity and integrity.
note: Official section heading. Read the explanation and constitutional protections; lawful criticism is not automatically an offence.

title: Bribery
meaning: Defines bribery in connection with electoral rights.
note: Official section heading. This is an election offence definition; public-servant corruption involves separate legislation.

title: Unlawful assembly
meaning: Addresses an assembly of five or more persons with one of the specified common objects.
note: Official section heading. A gathering or peaceful protest is not unlawful solely because of its size.

title: Rioting
meaning: Addresses force or violence by an unlawful assembly in pursuit of its common object.
note: Official section heading. The assembly, common object, role and facts require assessment.

title: Promoting enmity between different groups on grounds of religion, race, place of birth, residence, language, etc., and doing acts prejudicial to maintenance of harmony
quote: Promoting enmity between different groups on grounds of religion, race, place of birth, residence, language, etc., and doing acts prejudicial to maintenance of harmony.
meaning: Addresses specified promotion of enmity and acts affecting harmony between groups.
note: Official section heading. Read each ingredient and qualification; offensive expression alone does not settle the legal test.

title: Giving false evidence
meaning: Defines giving false evidence when legally bound to tell the truth in the circumstances specified.
note: Official section heading. Punishment and procedural conditions appear in related provisions; mistakes are not automatically perjury.

title: Causing disappearance of evidence of offence, or giving false information to screen offender
quote: Causing disappearance of evidence of offence, or giving false information to screen offender.
meaning: Addresses specified concealment of evidence or false information intended to screen an offender.
note: Official section heading. Preserve evidence and obtain legal advice; do not alter or destroy records.

title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
quote: Rash driving or riding on a public way.
meaning: Addresses rash or negligent driving or riding on a public way that endangers life or is likely to cause hurt.
note: Official section heading. Other offences and compensation provisions depend on the injury and evidence.
keywords: accident rash driving road bike car

title: Deliberate and malicious acts, intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs
quote: Deliberate and malicious acts, intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs.
meaning: Addresses deliberate and malicious acts intended to outrage religious feelings in the specified manner.
note: Official section heading. The intention and legal ingredients matter; do not equate all criticism with this offence.

title: Theft
meaning: Addresses dishonest taking of movable property from another’s possession without consent.
note: Official section heading. Read the explanations, illustrations and punishment conditions.
keywords: theft stolen stealing phone wallet money

title: Snatching
meaning: Addresses sudden or forcible seizure, grabbing or taking of movable property to commit theft.
note: Official section heading. The facts distinguish snatching from other theft or robbery offences.

title: Extortion
meaning: Addresses dishonestly inducing delivery of property or specified documents by putting a person in fear of injury.
note: Official section heading. Threats, delivery and the applicable subsection matter.

title: Robbery
meaning: Defines when theft or extortion becomes robbery through specified violence, restraint or fear.
note: Official section heading. Read the timing and presence requirements in the definition.

title: Dacoity
meaning: Addresses robbery involving five or more persons conjointly committing, attempting or aiding it as specified.
note: Official section heading. The group size and each person’s participation matter.

title: Dishonest misappropriation of property
meaning: Addresses dishonest misappropriation or conversion of movable property to one’s own use.
note: Official section heading. Illustrations and knowledge distinguish innocent possession from criminal conduct.

title: Criminal breach of trust
meaning: Addresses dishonest misappropriation or misuse of property entrusted to a person in the statutory circumstances.
note: Official section heading. Entrustment and dishonesty are essential; a contractual dispute is not automatically this offence.

title: Cheating
meaning: Addresses deception that dishonestly or fraudulently induces delivery or the other harmful action or omission specified.
note: Official section heading. A broken promise or unpaid debt does not automatically establish dishonest intention at the required time.

title: Cheating by personation
meaning: Addresses cheating by pretending to be another person or substituting one person for another.
note: Official section heading. Digital impersonation may also involve the Information Technology Act.

title: Mischief
meaning: Addresses intentional or knowing destruction or alteration of property causing the specified wrongful loss or damage.
note: Official section heading. Damage, intention and the applicable value or circumstance provisions matter.

title: Criminal trespass and house-trespass
meaning: Addresses entry or remaining on property with the specified criminal intention, and house-trespass.
note: Official section heading. A civil boundary or tenancy dispute alone does not prove these elements.

title: Forgery
meaning: Addresses making a false document or electronic record with specified fraudulent intent.
note: Official section heading. Section 335 explains making a false document; specialised forms appear in later sections.
keywords: forgery fake document signature electronic record

title: Criminal intimidation
meaning: Addresses threats of specified injury intended to cause alarm or compel a person to act or refrain from acting.
note: Official section heading. The precise threat, intent and context matter.

title: Defamation
meaning: Addresses making or publishing specified imputations that harm reputation, subject to exceptions.
note: Official section heading. Read all exceptions, explanations and procedural requirements; truth and public good issues need case-specific advice.
